A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there are several gaps in the literature that need to be addressed to improve screening in persons at familial risk of colorectal cancer.
there are a number of gaps in our understanding of the contribution of family cancer history (FCH) to colorectal cancer ( CRC ) risk and its clinical applications.

we need a better system for collecting and communicating family history.
